subject: Is the include argument working in rstan::stan?

messages.author: 77e72e34bf8c033f
messages.subject: Is the include argument working in rstan::stan?
parts:
Hi all

I am having problems getting the include argument of rstan::stan to work. The code below does not seem to respect the value of include, at least the same parameters are included in the fitted results regardless of its value. Am I doing something wrong?

I am running rstan 2.8 from CRAN.

Best Per

library(rstan)
scode <- "
parameters {
  real a; 
  real b;
  real y[3];

} 
model {
  y ~ normal(0, 1);
  a ~ normal(0, 1);
  b ~ double_exponential(0, 2);
} 
"
fit1F <- stan(model_code = scode, iter = 10, include = TRUE, pars = c('y')) 
fit1T <- stan(model_code = scode, iter = 10, include = FALSE, pars = c('y')) 

fit2F <- stan(model_code = scode, iter = 10, include = TRUE, pars = c('a')) 
fit2T <- stan(model_code = scode, iter = 10, include = FALSE, pars = c('a'))

[[1]]
[1] "y[1]" "y[2]" "y[3]" "lp__"

What do you get for names() on each of those stanfit objects?

Ben
